overview_description.description: Zeekeez is the 1st UAE’s Property Portal for Individuals and professionals. Thousands of properties for sale and for rent in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and in the UAE. Zeekeez is a property website in the UAE connecting buyers, sellers, tenants, agents and developers built by expats who are tired by basic portals, lack of transparency and hidden properties. We are not just another portal, we decided to help millions of residents who live in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and in the UAE by providing unprecedented user experience, innovative features and the strongest technology.

product.name: Property Listing Portal
product.description: An online platform for browsing and searching properties for sale and rent across the UAE, including residential and commercial real estate.

product.name: Mortgage Information and Comparison Service
product.description: A service providing information on mortgage options, types, and loan processes available in the UAE real estate market.

product.name: Property Search and Filtering Tools
product.description: Interactive tools that enable users to refine property searches by criteria such as location, price, size, type, bedrooms, bathrooms, and furnishing.

product.name: User Account and Profile Management
product.description: A feature allowing users to create accounts, save preferences, and manage property search criteria on the Zeekeez platform.
